description: This Java source file defines the 'Trace' class, which implements a method operation for tracing execution within the MiniLang framework. It handles the 'trace' element, manages trace levels, and executes nested operations with trace logging.

classes.name: Trace
classes.description: Implements a trace operation that toggles tracing on and off during execution of nested operations, based on a specified level.

classes.name: Trace.TraceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of Trace from XML elements.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Trace object, validates attributes, and reads nested operations.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the trace operation, turning tracing on, executing nested operations, then turning tracing off.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Trace object, including its level.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a Trace instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'trace'.
